info.title: Zipp API
info.description: M2 identity/accounts, M3 finance, M4 drivers/pricing and M5 rides/dispatch, M6 deliveries and M7.1 live participant contracts; runtime verification pending. Local OTP/payment/storage/routing adapters are not production providers. Financial 202 responses represent persisted operations, not confirmation of payment. M4 quotes expire in two minutes and use labelled development fares.

x-realtime.description: M7.1 minimal participant projections; reauthenticate and reauthorize every cycle. Read-only. Reconnect via current JWT and REST resync; public capability tokens are excluded. No chat/calling/media claim.
